title: SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
description:
Role Descriptions: Application Design Build cloud-ready custom applications using the SAP BTP ABAP Environment and RAP for both managed and unmanaged scenarios. Core Data Services (CDS) Create and optimize Interface| Projection| and Consumption CDS views with appropriate analytical or transactional annotations. Behavior Logic Implement Behavior Definitions| Behavior Implementations| validations| determinations| and draft handling. Services UI Develop Service Definitions and Service Bindings to expose OData services| supporting Fiori Elements and SAPUI5 user interfaces. Data Processing Use Entity Manipulation Language (EML) for complex transactional processing. Integration Connect SAP BTP applications with SAP and non-SAP systems via APIs| web services| and cloud connectors. Quality Assurance Conduct code reviews| ensure adherence to ABAP Cloud developer guidelines| and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks across layers.
  
  
Essential Skills: BTP RAP

title: Senior Odoo Technical Consultant
description:
🚀
 **We're Hiring: Senior Odoo Technical Consultant** 




 📍 Infopark Thrissur, Koratty \| 🕒 Full\-Time \| 💼 5\+ Years Experience
 



 Are you an Odoo expert who enjoys designing solutions, not just building them? We're looking for a
 **Senior Odoo Technical Consultant** 
 to lead the design, development, integration and deployment of enterprise\-grade Odoo ERP solutions, and to guide a growing development team.
 



**What you'll do** 




 🔹 Design scalable, secure and upgrade\-friendly Odoo solutions
 



 🔹 Develop and customise modules, workflows, reports and dashboards
 



 🔹 Build REST API integrations with HRMS, Payroll, CRM, banking, payment gateway and e\-commerce platforms
 



 🔹 Lead technical workstreams, run code reviews and mentor junior developers
 



 🔹 Manage deployments, version upgrades, migrations and performance tuning
 



 🔹 Take part in client workshops and technical discussions
 



**What we're looking for** 




 ✅ 5\+ years of hands\-on Odoo development and technical consulting
 



 ✅ Multiple end\-to\-end Odoo implementations
 



 ✅ Advanced Python and strong PostgreSQL skills
 



 ✅ Deep knowledge of the Odoo framework, ORM, security, automated actions and scheduled jobs
 



 ✅ Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML and Git
 



 ✅ Working knowledge of Linux, plus exposure to Azure, AWS or Docker
 



 ✅ Bachelor's degree in CS, IT, Software Engineering, Computer Applications or a related field
 



**Nice to have** 




 ⭐ Odoo Technical Certification
 



 ⭐ Experience with Odoo 16, 17 or newer
 



 ⭐ Kubernetes, CI/CD and DevOps practices
 



 ⭐ Multi\-company or multi\-country Odoo environments
 



 If you're ready to own the technical side of ERP implementations, we'd like to hear from you.
 



 Know someone who fits? Tag them or share this post! 🙌

title: Integration Engineer
description:
* Responsible for delivering working integrations using platforms such as
 **Mirth** 
 and
 **MuleSoft** 
 .
* Build and maintain APIs, interfaces, message flows, data transformations and system\-to\-system connections.
* Strong practical experience with:
* REST APIs
* SQL
* JSON
* Webhooks
* OAuth2 / OpenID Connect
* API security
* Data mapping and transformation
* Support identity and access integrations, including
 **Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, SSO, RBAC and service accounts** 
 .
* Troubleshoot integration issues, monitor data flows, investigate failures and support production services.
* Work directly with vendors and internal teams to understand requirements, test APIs and resolve integration issues.
* Create clear technical documentation for integrations, mappings, endpoints and support processes.
* Healthcare integration experience would be highly valued, especially
 **HL7 v2, ADT/ORU messages, FHIR, clinical workflows and patient identity data** 
 .
* Experience with AI\-related integrations would be useful, including connecting enterprise systems to Cally, Copilot or other AI\-enabled services.
* This is a practical delivery role — the focus is on
 **building, configuring, testing, troubleshooting and supporting integrations** 
 , not enterprise architecture or strategy.
* To adhere to the Information Security Management policies and procedures
